en.title: Longest Substring with Even Occurrences
en.description:
Find the longest contiguous substring in which every English letter occurs an even number of times; if no non-empty substring exists, output 0.

This site's standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: One line containing a string of only lowercase English letters, 1≤|S|≤100000.
en.explanation: Encode the parity of the occurrences of the 26 letters as a bitmask, and record the earliest position where each state appears.
